title: Clamp tooltip within viewport to prevent edge cutoffs
rationale: Currently the tooltip can run off the bottom/right edge (especially in lower panels), hurting legibility and forcing cursor re-positioning. Clamping keeps it readable without changing aesthetics.

title: Make marching-ants flow more legible (slower + rounded caps)
rationale: The dashflow reads a bit 'busy' in sequential frames; slowing it down and rounding linecaps improves continuity and reduces strobing while keeping the industrial aesthetic.

title: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for console animations
rationale: Live ops consoles are often used for long sessions; honoring reduced-motion improves accessibility and reduces fatigue without affecting default motion behavior.
